name: com.box-track/moving-tools
title: BoxTrack Moving Calculators
description: Free moving and home calculators and checklists: moving cost, truck size, boxes, storage unit, tips.

tools.name: show_home_inventory
tools.description: Use when someone wants a home or household inventory (for insurance, a move or a storage unit) from photos of their rooms, shelves or boxes, or from a description. You identify each item and estimate what it would cost to replace; this tool shows the list room by room with counts and totals, and offers to keep it in BoxTrack, a home inventory app that keeps a photo and value for each thing. Group small things ("about 40 books"). Only list what you can actually see or were told.

title.description: A short name for the list, like "Apartment inventory"

currency.description: ISO currency code for the values, default USD

rooms.description: Rooms, closets, bins or boxes, each with its items

name.description: Room or place, like "Living room" or "Garage shelf"
What it is, with brand and model when known

value.description: Estimated replacement value for one, in the currency

note.description: Optional: serial number, condition, where it sits

tools.name: home_inventory_checklist
tools.description: Use when someone asks how to make a home inventory for insurance, or what to include. Returns a room-by-room checklist of what to photograph and write down, from state insurance departments' and the Insurance Information Institute's advice, with a free printable PDF.

tools.name: find_my_stuff
tools.description: Use when the person asks where something of theirs is ("where are my passports?", "which box has the HDMI cables?"). Searches their BoxTrack items and shows each match with its photo and the box and room it is in. Only for the person's own BoxTrack account; the chat app asks them to connect it the first time.

query.description: What to look for, in a few words, like "passport" or "christmas lights"

tools.name: show_my_box
tools.description: Use when the person asks what is in one of their boxes, bins or rooms ("what's in the garage bins?"). Shows the box with photos of what is inside, its value and the boxes inside it. Only for the person's own BoxTrack account; the chat app asks them to connect it the first time.

box.description: The box, bin or room name as they said it

tools.name: my_inventory_value
tools.description: Use when the person asks what their things are worth, for insurance or a claim, or how complete their home inventory is. Shows the total, room by room, the most valuable items and how many have photos. Only for the person's own BoxTrack account; the chat app asks them to connect it the first time.

tools.name: list_my_items
tools.description: Use when the person asks for their items marked fragile, or tagged to ship, sell, store, donate or toss, items already sold, or items missing a photo or a value. Only for the person's own BoxTrack account; the chat app asks them to connect it the first time.

tools.name: my_boxes
tools.description: Use when the person asks what boxes or rooms they have in BoxTrack, or wants an overview. Shows every top-level room or box with photos, counts and values. Only for the person's own BoxTrack account; the chat app asks them to connect it the first time.

tools.name: check_insurance_coverage
tools.description: Use when someone asks how much their belongings are worth, how much personal property (Coverage C) or renters insurance they need, or whether they are underinsured. Estimates what the things in their home would cost to replace, room by room, against their coverage, and flags valuables over a standard policy's limits.

home.description: Own a house, own a condo, or rent. Default house.

extra_rooms.description: Other rooms with things in them (storage = basement, attic or storage)

fullness.description: Just the basics, lived-in (typical) or full to the brim

kind.description: jewelry: Jewelry and watches; gifts: Holiday gifts this year; tech: Laptops, cameras, gaming; art: Art and antiques; collect: Collectibles: cards, vinyl, toys; coins: Coins, bullion, cash; silver: Silverware and goldware; guns: Firearms; bikes: Bikes and sports gear; music: Musical instruments; work: Work or business gear

coverage_c.description: Personal property coverage (Coverage C) in US dollars, if known

dwelling_coverage.description: Dwelling coverage (Coverage A), if Coverage C isn't known (homeowners only)

tools.name: estimate_moving_cost
tools.description: Use when someone asks what a move will cost, or whether to hire movers or do it themselves. Gives a rough range for doing it yourself, hiring movers, and movers who pack too, side by side, with what goes into it.

home.description: Size of the home: studio, 1br, 2br, 3br or 4br (4 or more bedrooms). Default 2br.

fullness.description: How much stuff: light, average (lived in) or full (every closet full). Default average.

way.description: The way they lean to: diy, movers, or full (movers pack too)

extras.description: stairs: Stairs, no elevator; peak: Summer or month-end; piano: A piano; storage: Storage in between; car: Ship a car; helpers: Hire loading help

tools.name: pick_moving_truck_size
tools.description: Use when someone asks what size moving or rental truck they need. Shows how full each truck size would be for their home or their own list of furniture and boxes.

home.description: Size of the home: studio, 1br, 2br, 3br or 4br (4 or more bedrooms). Default 2br.

fullness.description: How much stuff: light, average (lived in) or full (every closet full). Default average.

items.description: Optional: the actual furniture, appliances and boxes, when the person lists them. Replaces the typical home. Ids: sofa (Sofa), loveseat (Loveseat or sectional piece), chair (Armchair or recliner), coffee (Coffee or side table), tv (TV and stand), bookcase (Bookcase or cabinet), kingbed (King bed), queenbed (Queen or full bed), twinbed (Twin bed or bunk), dresser (Dresser or chest), nightstand (Nightstand), crib (Crib), table (Dining table), dchair (Dining chair), hutch (China cabinet or hutch), fridge (Fridge), washer (Washer), dryer (Dryer), freezer (Chest freezer), desk (Desk), ochair (Office chair), piano (Upright piano), treadmill (Treadmill or bike machine), weights (Weight bench and weights), bike (Bicycle), mower (Lawn mower), grill (Grill), patio (Patio set), tools (Tool chest or workbench), boxsm (Small boxes (books)), boxmd (Medium boxes), boxlg (Large boxes), wardrobe (Wardrobe boxes).

tools.name: estimate_moving_weight
tools.description: Use when someone asks how much their household goods weigh for a move, or whether they will go over a PCS (military) weight allowance or a weight-based quote.

home.description: Size of the home: studio, 1br, 2br, 3br or 4br (4 or more bedrooms). Default 2br.

fullness.description: How much stuff: light, average (lived in) or full (every closet full). Default average.

items.description: Optional: the actual furniture, appliances and boxes, when the person lists them. Replaces the typical home. Ids: sofa (Sofa), loveseat (Loveseat or sectional piece), chair (Armchair or recliner), coffee (Coffee or side table), tv (TV and stand), bookcase (Bookcase or cabinet), kingbed (King bed), queenbed (Queen or full bed), twinbed (Twin bed or bunk), dresser (Dresser or chest), nightstand (Nightstand), crib (Crib), table (Dining table), dchair (Dining chair), hutch (China cabinet or hutch), fridge (Fridge), washer (Washer), dryer (Dryer), freezer (Chest freezer), desk (Desk), ochair (Office chair), piano (Upright piano), treadmill (Treadmill or bike machine), weights (Weight bench and weights), bike (Bicycle), mower (Lawn mower), grill (Grill), patio (Patio set), tools (Tool chest or workbench), boxsm (Small boxes (books)), boxmd (Medium boxes), boxlg (Large boxes), wardrobe (Wardrobe boxes).

allowance_lbs.description: Their weight allowance or quoted weight in pounds, if any

furnished_rooms.description: Furnished rooms, not counting bathrooms, for the quick rule

tools.name: tip_movers
tools.description: Use when someone asks how much to tip movers or a moving crew. Works out a tip per mover from the hours, the crew and how hard the job was.

hard_work.description: stairs: Lots of stairs; heavy: Very heavy things; carry: A long walk to the truck; weather: Heat, rain or snow; fragile: Fragile or precious things

bill.description: The moving bill in dollars, if they want the percent way

tools.name: count_moving_boxes
tools.description: Use when someone asks how many moving boxes they need, or which sizes. Counts boxes by size and room, with tape and labels.

tools.name: pick_storage_unit_size
tools.description: Use when someone asks what size storage unit they need (5x5, 10x10, 10x20 and so on). Shows how full each common size would be.

home.description: What is going in, roughly: boxes (just boxes), studio, 1br, 2br, 3br or 4br

bedrooms.description: Optional: bedrooms of furniture, up to 6

living.description: Optional: living or dining rooms, up to 4

garage.description: Optional: garage, patio or office, up to 3

aisle.description: Leave an aisle to reach the back (default yes)

tools.name: price_garage_sale_items
tools.description: Use when someone asks what to charge at a garage or yard sale, or how to price things to sell. Suggests a price for each thing from what it cost new and its condition, or typical prices by kind of thing.

items.description: The things to price (leave out for the typical price list)

cost_new.description: What it cost new, in dollars, if known

condition.description: new (like new), good, or worn (well used)

category.description: Kind of thing, when the price new is unknown

tools.name: sort_for_downsizing
tools.description: Use when someone downsizing, decluttering or clearing a home asks whether to keep, sell, give to family, donate or toss things. Ask the questions you need, then sort each thing into a pile with the reason.

items.description: The things, with what you know about each

would_miss.description: Would they miss it, or does it mean a lot

could_sell_for_25.description: Could it sell for $25 or more

tools.name: moving_checklist
tools.description: Use when someone wants a checklist: moving (8 weeks out to moving day), change of address (who to tell), first night box (what to pack to open first), moving out (getting the deposit back), first apartment (what to buy), snowbird (closing up one home for the season), pcs_move (military PCS inventory) or questions_for_movers (what to ask a moving company, and red flags). Shows it as a list they can tick off, with a free printable PDF.

tools.name: inventory_template
tools.description: Use when someone wants a template, spreadsheet or printable for: a moving inventory list, a home inventory for insurance, a storage unit inventory, a customs inventory list for an international move, an estate or downsizing inventory, a PCS high-value inventory, moving box labels, holiday storage labels, QR code bin labels, a Goodreads library to Excel, or a bookshelf photo to a spreadsheet. Shows what it includes and how to fill it in, with the free download.

tools.name: show_book_list
tools.description: Use when someone shares photos of their bookshelves or lists their books and wants a list of their library or what their books are worth. You read the spines (title and author, rough value new); this tool shows it shelf by shelf. Only list what you can read.

name.description: Shelf name, like "Living room, top shelf"

value.description: Rough replacement value new, US dollars
